lessons_used: Layout changes to the path selection stage significantly improved conversion.
Interactive walkthrough redesigns, new adoption flows, sign-in reassurance hints, and path selection incentives significantly hurt conversion.
Copy changes, step reordering, wait-time info and notifications, photo upload guidance, and layout changes to other stages showed no clear effect.
Predictions were too low for path selection stage layout changes.
Predictions were too high for interactive walkthrough redesigns, new adoption flows, sign-in hints, and path selection incentives.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Card Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate screen to a card layout featuring structured pet identity fields and official confirmation cards.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops significantly to 60.9% with long mean completion times (1017s); a clean card layout streamlines certificate confirmation.

guard.reason: Valid card layout redesign of the adoption certificate screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has high dropoff, but previous adoption redesigns resulted in a -2.1% lift.

candidates.title: Story Screen Split Screen Layout
candidates.change: Re-layout the story screen using a split view layout combining story visuals on one side with onboarding narrative copy on the other.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has a mean duration of 514s; presenting story context in a side-by-side split layout helps users digest information faster.

guard.reason: Valid split layout redesign of the story screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Layout changes on path selection are proven to work well (+6.3% historically).

candidates.title: New Desktop Companion Setup Screen
candidates.change: Insert a new screen before the waiting stage to introduce desktop overlay permissions and screen placement options.
candidates.why: Three support emails reported pets failing to show on the desktop or the app failing to open upon initial render.

new_desktop_setup.headline: Desktop Setup & Permissions
new_desktop_setup.body: Configure your screen overlay preferences so your new pet can freely roam on your desktop.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a desktop setup screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Adding new adoption/setup screens historically degrades funnel conversion significantly.

candidates.title: Persistent Account Sync Sign In Copy
candidates.change: Update the sign-in headline and body copy to assure users that signing in permanently saves and syncs their desktop pet to their account.
candidates.why: 8 support tickets (the largest bug category) cited missing or reset pets after signing back into their accounts.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Sync & Protect Your Pet
sign_in.body: Your pet customization and progress are automatically saved to your cloud account so you never lose them.

guard.reason: Valid sign-in copy update maintaining the required sign-in screen function.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from 8 support tickets and high dropoff; low cost copy edit though copy changes have minimal impact.

candidates.title: Home Intro Split Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the home intro completion screen into a split layout clearly separating desktop controls from interaction guides.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet, and finish step conversion is 64.8%.

guard.reason: Valid layout redesign of the home intro screen.

candidates.score_note: Finish stage has high dropoff and support complaints, but redesigns at this stage scored -8.7% previously.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Realtime Progress Timer
candidates.change: Add an explicit time estimate switch and visual progress timer component on the pet generation waiting screen.
candidates.why: The waiting step (home target step) takes a mean time of 2336s, leading to user dropoff without visual timing feedback.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a progress timer for a real generation wait time.

candidates.score_note: High wait time on home, but wait info changes showed slightly negative impact (-1.2%) in past tests.

candidates.title: Upload Photos Resolution Hint
candidates.change: Add a photo quality guidance hint explaining optimal lighting and framing on the photo upload screen.
candidates.why: Support received multiple complaints about custom pet creation failing or producing distorted results.

upload_photos.hint: For best results, upload well-lit, front-facing photos with clear background contrast.

guard.reason: Valid photo upload guidance hint added within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Adoption step drops many users, but guidance hints historically show no clear effect on conversion.

candidates.title: Quick Choice Cards Sign In Options
candidates.change: Replace standard sign in option elements with formatted quick choice cards for sign in methods.
candidates.why: Sign in conversion sits at 72.9% with stall reports; replacing options with clear visual choice cards speeds up sign-in selection.

guard.reason: 'sign_in.replace.sign_in_options[0]': nothing on the sign-in screen may lead past it without signing in

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Before Sign In Order
candidates.change: Move sign_in to occur immediately after completing the adoption certificate step rather than before pet creation.
candidates.why: Adoption drops off significantly (60.9%); placing pet adoption before sign in builds emotional investment before requesting account registration.

guard.reason: Valid reordering of sign-in after adoption certificate as permitted by onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Reordering sign_in achieved +2.2% previously by delaying sign-in until after initial value.

candidates.title: Choose Path Journey Expectations Copy
candidates.change: Update choose path body copy to outline the quick adoption steps immediately following path selection.
candidates.why: Choose path stage has a high mean duration (514s), indicating user hesitation when picking a path without clear expectations.

choose_path.body: Select your companion path to begin. You can choose a pre-made pet or create a unique custom companion in just a few steps.

guard.reason: Valid copy update that preserves both adopting and creating a custom pet choices.

candidates.score_note: Config-only copy change for choose_path; past test yielded -0.3% lift.

picked: Adoption Certificate Before Sign In Order

decisions.title: Adoption Certificate Before Sign In Order

lessons_next: Path selection stage layout upgrades and waiting screen realtime progress timers significantly improved conversion.
Interactive walkthrough redesigns, home intro redesigns, new adoption flows, sign-in reassurance hints, sign-in reordering, and path selection incentives significantly hurt conversion.
Copy changes, background notifications, photo upload guidance, and layout changes to sign-in, adoption, or story screens showed no clear effect.
Predictions were too low for path selection stage layout upgrades and waiting screen progress timers.
Predictions were too high for interactive walkthrough redesigns, home intro redesigns, new adoption flows, sign-in hints and reordering, and path selection incentives.
